commit_message: Keep one current host attachment per physical disk

replacements.old:
cursor.execute(
                            f"DELETE FROM {host_disks} WHERE host_id=%s "
                            "AND (disk_id=%s OR device_name=%s)",
                            (host_id, disk_id, item.device_name),
                        )
replacements.new:
cursor.execute(
                            f"DELETE FROM {host_disks} WHERE disk_id=%s "
                            "OR (host_id=%s AND device_name=%s)",
                            (disk_id, host_id, item.device_name),
                        )

replacements.old: self.assertTrue(any("`hub_host_disks`" in item for item in disks))
replacements.new:
self.assertTrue(any("`hub_host_disks`" in item for item in disks))
        self.assertTrue(any("UNIQUE KEY `uq_host_disk` (`disk_id`)" in item for item in disks))

replacements.old: - tabulka `host_disks` dovolí sledovat fyzický přesun stejného disku mezi servery,
replacements.new: - tabulka `host_disks` drží jedinou aktuální vazbu disku; synchronizace na novém hostu automaticky nahradí starý host a dovolí sledovat fyzický přesun,
